personality_one_liner: An editorial yet tactile habit tracking experience structured around individual monthly GitHub-style habit dashboards.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room, comfortable touch targets, 12-16px padding on cards, sticky bottom action bar.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers and floating bottom action bars
Apply translucent tinted base ≥70% opacity for foreground readability
dont's: Never blur form fields or entire screens
Never stack more than two blur surfaces

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Google social login and email/password account creation with clean editorial feel.

states.empty: Sign in to access your synchronized habit dashboards.
states.error: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and retry.

screens.layout: Centered clean branding, email/password input fields with labels above, Google sign-in button with icon, toggle between sign in and sign up.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Scrollable vertical collection of independent habit dashboards with monthly GitHub-style calendars and drag-and-rearrange.

states.empty: No habits tracked yet. Tap '+ Add Habit' below to start your journey.
states.error: Failed to load habits. Tap retry to reconnect.

screens.layout: Header with app title, date indicator, theme toggle, and profile avatar. Vertical list of card components representing each habit with name, streak counter, month navigation, GitHub-style monthly calendar grid, daily activity cells, and statistics summary. Sticky bottom '+ Add Habit' CTA bar.

screens.name: AddHabit
screens.purpose: Create a new habit specifying name, icon, yes/no or measurable type, target value, and unit.

states.empty: Configure your new habit parameters above.
states.error: Please fill in all required fields correctly.

screens.layout: Modal form with keyboard avoiding view, text input for habit name, icon selector grid, segmented control for habit type (Yes/No vs Measurable), target value input, unit selector, and sticky primary Save button.

screens.name: DayDetailModal
screens.purpose: Inspect or edit specific day's completion value or status with confetti celebration effect.

states.empty: No entry for this date yet.

screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal displaying selected date, input field for measurable habits or toggle button for Yes/No habits, status indicator, and confirm button.

auth_background.alt: Minimalist geometric backdrop for habit tracker

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure every habit has its own independent monthly GitHub-style calendar card stacked vertically on the dashboard. Implement month navigation per habit, day cell tapping with confetti animation for Yes/No completion and progressive green shades for measurable habits. Add long-press drag-and-rearrange directly on the dashboard. Support Google social login and email/password authentication. Provide an in-app dark/light mode toggle with device-following default.
